thread:
Rae (Growth): Quick 10m: were finalizing launch posts + webinar funnel. Need final KW mapping, JSON-LD for landing, internal anchors from pillar pages, sitemap pruning, and a reversible redirect plan that preserves UTMs. Who can pick which? :eyes:
Min-SEO: Ill own KW mapping + meta variants. Thinking less on the "predictable" phrasing and more on "inference performance budgeting" and "token-efficient inference" long tails.
Harper-Content: I'll write the benchmark blurb and two invite lines (technical and executive). Keep them concrete: throughput/$ and p50 latency numbers.
Zoe-Integrations: For forms we will capture utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, and utm_term into hidden fields: 'kw_tag' and 'utm_stack'. Also will add a region param to route leads to SDR queues.
Infra-Bot: Crawl snapshot: 5 pages with conflicting canonical, 2 redirect chains, 4 pages missing Event schema candidates. Snapshot: https://internal.crawl/1745554321/snap
Min-SEO: KW shortlist (draft): "inference performance budgeting", "token efficient inference", "reduce LLM p50 latency", "inference cost per request", "batching for low-latency inference". Mapping: H1 variants and meta A/B ready.
Rae (Growth): Internal anchor plan: use topic-cluster anchors from pillar posts 'economics of serving', 'runtime tricks', 'deployment patterns'. Anchor text variations limited to 3: "performance budgeting", "reduce p50 latency", "token-efficient inference". No /pricing links in blog flow.
Harper-Content: Benchmark hook (exec): "See throughput per dollar improvements and realistic p50 latency wins in our live benchmark." Tech hook: "Live demo + bench: p50 latency, batching gains, and tokens saved."
Min-SEO: Schema plan: Event + Person (speakers) + HowTo (post-webinar steps). Recommend including potentialAction for registration and usesOnlineAccess true. Will draft JSON-LD snippet and PR.
Zoe-Integrations: Redirect plan: push via CDN edge using a feature-flagged rule that rewrites legacy promo to new landing while preserving query string. Start as 302 for 48h, flip to 301 if conversions stable. We'll maintain an automated rollback that reverts the edge rule within 15 minutes on flag.
Infra-Bot: Proposed rewrite snippet (CDN pseudo):
```
# feature-flagged temp redirect (preserve query)
if (feature_redirect_launch) {
  rewrite /promo/legacy -> /webinar/inference-playbook?$query_string status=302;
}
# flip to 301 when flag off
```
I'll run a validation crawl 6h after flip.
Min-SEO: Meta A focuses on throughput-per-dollar; Meta B focuses on latency improvements. We'll A/B for 14 days. Tracking: attribute utm_term->kw_tag in CRM.
Harper-Content: I'll post the 1-paragraph benchmark narrative in the content PR and include both invite lines for email/LinkedIn.
Sam-PR: Reminder: legal wants no claims of specific $ savings without case study approval. Keep wording "up to" out unless verified. Use percent/relative language when possible.
Rae (Growth): Owners: Min = KW + schema; Harper = benchmark copy + invite; Zoe = form fields + routing; Infra-Bot = redirect feature-flag + validation crawl; Sam-PR = compliance check. I'll assemble checklist and schedule a 9am PT follow-up. Thanks all. :rocket:
